verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 7 258V is a processor, a hardware component that users do not operate through commands of any kind, so natural-language operation is a category error for this product type. The one voice-command mention (docs-7) describes Microsoft's Copilot+ software running on Intel-powered PCs, not a capability of the chip itself, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
